debit.notes: Contact centre is 24x7 ("Toll free 7x24 help line"); the same two numbers serve calls from abroad — report the loss, answer the security questions, and the card is blocked with a ticket number issued. Any SBI branch can hotlist the card on a written request. Netbanking: SBI pages link "TO BLOCK DEBIT CARD" to https://retail.onlinesbi.sbi/retail/blockatmcardintermediate.htm. No SMS block format is published for debit cards — the "ATM <ticket no>" SMS to 567676 only tracks ATM-complaint tickets. Same numbers appear as 1800 11 2211 and 1800 425 3800 on the contact page; number2 1800 11 1109 is the line for reporting unauthorised electronic transactions (also 94491 12211 mobile, toll free, and 080-2659 9990 chargeable). E-mail customercare@sbi.co.in.

credit.notes: Lost/stolen credit card: 24X7 helpline — dial 39 02 02 02 (prefix local STD code) or 1860 180 1290; in the IVR press 2 to report a lost/stolen card. 1860 500 1290 is also listed; 1800 180 1290 is the toll-free line. Online: log in at sbicard.com and click "Block Lost \Stolen Card" (FAQ: "Requests" tab > "Report Lost/Stolen Card"). SBI Card mobile app: Menu > Service Request > "Report Lost/Stolen". A blocked card cannot be reactivated — a replacement with a new number is issued to the registered address. Customer-care desk hours 8 AM-8 PM Mon-Sat; e-mail customercare@sbicard.com. No overseas number is published for personal cards; corporate cardholders abroad are directed to Visa's 24X7 toll-free emergency helpline.
credit.sms: SMS BLOCK XXXX to 5676791 from your registered mobile no. (XXXX = Last 4 digits of your SBI Card)

upi.notes: UPI FAQ (Disable/Re-enable): a) BHIM SBI Pay (Disabling): "Log in BHIM SBI Pay > hamburger menu > Disable UPI Services > Select Account"; b) Contact Centre: "call on 1800 1234/1800 2100" with registered mobile no/account no; c) "visit any nearest SBI branch" (BHIM SBI Pay FAQ: "stop the facility by contacting your home branch and giving a written request"). Lost phone: "Immediately you need to disable the UPI services by contacting SBI contact center or by approaching nearest any SBI branch." De-register VPA: BHIM SBI Pay app "main menu and use the De-Register option to de-register the UPI facility". UPI also runs on YONO SBI (YONO Pay UPI); complaints via crcf.sbi.co.in, support.upi@sbi.co.in, or toll-free 1800112211 / 18004253800. No netbanking UPI manage path and no USSD/SMS keyword published on official pages.
